_comment: The Leaders screen (SCREEN_OFFICERS, 29), work order 167. Everything it draws is placed at the HD image of its native rectangle (ldrgeom, through core/researchnative), so this file carries no geometry: only the markings, one per thing HD does that the original does not, or leaves out, or cannot fill yet. Each is also stated in the module that performs it, in v3_projektstatus.md, and held by a smoke check (tools/smoke_suite/090a..090c).

marks.hd_state: BUILT, NOT ACCEPTED. The live part of work order 167 is parked (doc/briefs/167-parked-for-data.md, item L).
marks._note: Decision 61. The same sentence stands in the module docstring of screens/leaders/screen.py and in v3_projektstatus.md, and a smoke check fails if it leaves either.
marks.omission_outer_frame: OMISSION — the original paints its rails, panels and the pool/dismiss button faces into OFFICER.LBX 0, one 640x480 picture (officer.cpp:648). The work order leaves every outer frame out ('frames come later over the finished structure'), so HD draws on black and puts its own inner boxes where the original's panels are.
marks.deviation_inner_boxes_drawn: DEVIATION — the four leader rows, the galaxy box and the two strips are boxes drawn in code (a fill and a plate, the research screens' look, work order 166 C) where the original has panels painted into OFFICER.LBX 0. The view box wears the original's own box art (OFFICER.LBX 1 / 2) when it is extracted.
marks.deviation_hd_font: DEVIATION — the original's bitmap fonts 0, 2 and 3 become the HD font, at a size taken from the native line pitch (ldrdraw.NATIVE_TEXT) and shrunk to the original's own width where it would overflow: the original squeezes, HD shrinks.
marks.hd_extension_sprite_scale: HD EXTENSION — portraits, skill icons, stars and ship pictures at an INTEGER magnification (the Fleets rule, decision 28); buttons, the view box art and the popup at the exact HD size of their native rectangle, nearest-neighbour, so every pixel is the original's and the art stays under the fields it belongs to.
marks.deviation_button_words: DEVIATION — without the extracted art a button is its rectangle and a word read off the art (officer.cpp passes an empty help string to every button, so there is none to transcribe).
marks.deviation_hd_skill_help: DEVIATION — a right click on a skill line opens HD's own box with the text the original's TEXTBOX::Text_Box_ would show (officer.cpp:1761-1792, SKILDESC.LBX); the game's box is not opened, because the answer is display-only and fully known to HD.
marks.transcription_hover: TRANSCRIPTION, drawn by HD alone — the leader under the pointer is lit and, in hire mode, priced, as `_officer_scanned` does in the original (officer.cpp:1320-1336, :796-808). The API has no mouse motion, so HD resolves the row itself and sends nothing.
marks.hd_state_open_fix_30: HD STATE — the button mode beyond hire, the selection, the colony view's star, the ship view's stack and grid and the hire popup's leader are not on the wire without open fix 30 (doc/ext_officer_screen_state.patch, NOT APPLIED). Until then the view box shows a placeholder that names the fix, POOL / DISMISS / PREV / NEXT / assigning / the galaxy box send nothing, and a popup whose leader the list cannot name shows the game's own pixels.
marks.omission_system_pictures: OMISSION — the colony view's system display: the star and planet pictures are not drawn (their artwork is not extracted by this order); HD writes the star's name and its planet slots. Only with open fix 30.
marks.omission_map_strip: OMISSION — the strip under the galaxy box names the stack the GAME's pointer is over (Print_Galmap_Scanned_Ship_, officer.cpp:2094-2204): ship counts by hull, which HD does not build in this order. The strip stays empty.
marks.omission_detailed_ship_view: OMISSION — a right click on a big ship icon opens the combat screen's ship view (CMBTDRW1::Detailed_View_Ship_, officer.cpp:1041-1047). Not built; with open fix 30 the click reaches the game and its answer is the fallback picture.
